name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.read.SpeechVoiceReadPaperLandingActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK opens this advertiser-branded page for a reading ad. It shows the reward, reading instructions, and a task control, then checks reading progress and displays the next step.
disableEffect: Blocking it removes the SDK's reading offer screen; users cannot complete this ad-reading task or receive its reading reward.
